entries.062260441ea67a37: A specialized trading company for chemicals, centered on oleochemicals derived from natural fats and oils, which also handles daily necessities and civil engineering and construction materials.
entries.0761d4ce1b7a97f2: Chemical products centered on oleochemicals and related products
entries.0888b297c201c312: This business model centers on the chemicals business, which procures oleochemicals and surfactants from fat and oil manufacturers and sells them to intermediate and final product manufacturers, and earns revenue from the planning and sale of daily necessities and the sale of civil engineering and construction materials.

entries.152b283943ab90f5: Petrochemical products (PEG, EO derivatives, PO derivatives, etc.)
entries.166de86b98102e58: The company sells bioremediation agents for purifying contaminated soil and agents using magnesium oxide for solidifying and insolubilizing contaminated soil. The purification agent "Soybean Whey Product SoyBio MA" and the solidifying and insolubilizing agent both have exclusive domestic sales rights.
entries.18dbc13350b5583c: Based on segment information and information by major customer, the business overview, and the status of affiliated companies.
entries.1bd53c6dda20264d: Chemical manufacturers and civil engineering and construction companies
entries.25fbcb52d94735b6: In the chemicals business, it purchases and sells chemicals such as oleochemicals and surfactants; in the daily necessities business, it plans, purchases and sells household detergents and other products; and in the civil engineering and construction materials business, it sells ground improvement agents, concrete repair and reinforcement materials and environmental remediation agents.
entries.2abfdc433c1c77c6: The company purchases oleochemicals such as fatty acids, fatty amines, fatty alcohols and glycerin, and surfactants derived from them, made from natural fats and oils such as palm oil, coconut oil and palm kernel oil, from oil and fat manufacturers and sells them to intermediate and final product manufacturers.
entries.2bc0992c5085efeb: The company sells materials and additives used in ground improvement methods such as jet grout methods and in concrete repair and reinforcement methods. For the jet grout method, as an agent of Kao Corporation, the company has exclusive domestic sales rights for the cement admixture designated as the basic design chemical.
entries.329557143f215235: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it adopts a concentration strategy of focusing human, physical and information management resources on its business domain, the 'chemical products field centered on oleochemicals,' and aims to deepen its markets in the chemicals, daily necessities and civil engineering and construction materials businesses and to maximize synergies among the three businesses through effective use of information management resources.
entries.35d9f15179134b78: Oleochemicals (fatty acids, fatty amines, fatty alcohols, glycerin, etc.)
entries.39ee9151d419aa65: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Osaka, and forms a group with two consolidated subsidiaries. Its main business is the Chemical Products Business, whose main product handled is oleochemicals, which are fat and oil chemicals derived from natural fats and oils. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 80. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.42f2a5603e1ad09b: It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and the company and two consolidated subsidiaries form the group. Its head office is in Chuo-ku, Osaka, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 80.
entries.4591654f8129a3eb: It procures raw materials for oleochemicals and surfactants from fat and oil manufacturers and delivers them through intermediate product manufacturers to final product manufacturers, with a structure that covers the distribution of chemical raw materials broadly from upstream to downstream. It seeks to differentiate itself by hearing customers' development themes and manufacturing challenges and supporting new product development from the perspective of raw material selection. In the civil engineering and construction materials business, it holds exclusive sales positions for raw materials for specific construction methods, including admixtures for the jet grouting method and contaminated soil remediation agents.
entries.4b69c518a7c46957: Petrochemical Products and Other Chemical Products
entries.4d99a716dcf97d75: It is a chemicals trading company specializing in oleochemicals derived from natural fats and oils, and the chemicals business accounts for the majority of revenue. Its main supplier is Kao Corporation, with which it also has a sales relationship, and Sanyo Chemical Industries, Ltd. is disclosed as a major customer. It has consolidated subsidiaries in China and Thailand and also sells in Asia.
entries.5e1fa84d2b56a86c: This business purchases and sells materials and additives used in ground improvement methods such as grout (chemical injection) methods and in concrete repair and reinforcement methods, as well as environmental remediation agents for improving contaminated soil. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,295 million.
entries.602d0ffeea5c2e8c: This business purchases and sells chemical products, including oleochemicals such as fatty acids, fatty amines, fatty alcohols and glycerin, and surfactants, which are derivatives of these. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,899 million. It is conducted by the company, Shoei Xiang (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd. and SHOEI TRADING (THAILAND) CO.,LTD.
entries.611d3b355e07681d: Daily necessities such as household detergents (supplied under customers' brands)
entries.6a154d5c12778423: The company sells petrochemical products such as PEG, EO derivatives and PO derivatives as raw materials for surfactants, and synthetic resins, solvents and mineral oils, inorganic chemicals, pigments and fragrances as other chemical products, to manufacturers of automotive parts, home appliances, electronic components, daily necessities and FRP products, among others.
entries.7143edad2b61bef1: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥557 million.

entries.76ca0e4efea8f07f: Ground improvement and repair and reinforcement materials
entries.7782df61a8bb89e8: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥557 million, up 5.6% from the previous consolidated fiscal year.
entries.7a54f1f8e7ca46c0: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,921 million, up 7.6% from the previous consolidated fiscal year.
